shots.action: Time-lapse: the light drops from sunset to deep night as the sky darkens to blue, headlights and distant lights flicker on, and the subject stays still.
shots.sound: Evening crickets swell as the wind dies down.

end.paint: Change the time to deep night: dark blue sky full of stars, the car's headlights on, warm light on the woman. Keep the same people, pose, framing and road.
